question: How is sixfold piercing-initiation prescribed in the Cave?
premises: sixfold in the glorious Cave, piercing-initiation prescribed by the supreme Lord
inference: Six vedha-modes in Gahvara: fiery kula, eight-star cakra onward.
plain_english: Sixfold in the glorious Cave, piercing-initiation prescribed by the supreme Lord — fiery kula as own-scripture states, cakra beginning with eight stars.
